title: Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Cranberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Cranberry Cherry Prefilled Pods are made for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a full-bodied berry mix. Each pod comes prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth MTL vape and up to 600 puffs. This flavour brings together sweet Blueberry, tart Cranberry, and rich Cherry for a rounded fruit experience that vapers will find satisfying. Pods can be replaced easily, ensuring a quick and mess-free vape.
